Appearance:
 Shri Kunjan Mittal - Advocate for the applicant.

Shri Sudarshan Joshi - Govt. Advocate for respondent/
 Order
1. This is third bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C / 483 of BNSS, 2023.

The applicant is being implicated in Crime No.578/2021, registered at police station Vijay Nagar, Indore, District Indore for commission of offence punishable under Section 363, 376(2)(n), 376(3) of IPC and Section 5(1) and 6 of POCSO Act, 2012.
2 . First application bearing M.Cr.C.No.54656/2021 was dismissed as withdrawn by order dated 23/11/2021.
Second application bearing M.Cr.C.No.15727/2022 was allowed by order dated 19/4/2022.

3. After being granted the benefit of bail by this Court on 19/4/2022 the applicant appeared before the trial Court and continued to appear for sometime but it appears that subsequent to 23/11/2023 he has not been appearing as a result of which arrest warrant was issued against him and he has been arrested on 27/9/2024.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:32075 2 MCRC-48140-2024 4.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant had appeared before the trial Court and was participating in the proceedings but could not appear on 23/11/2023 since he was not aware of the date of appearance and his counsel had also not appeared.

For that reason he could not Raj vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101320992/
1 acquire knowledge of the subsequent dates also.

sentences.text: It is submitted that the applicant shall diligently cooperate in the trial and there shall not be even a single non-appearance on his part.
It is hence submitted that applicant be enlarged on bail.

5 . The aforesaid prayer has been opposed by the learned counsel for respondent/State submitting that due to non-cooperation of the applicant the trial has been stalled for a period of almost one year hence the applicant does not deserve to be enlarged on bail.
6. I have considered the submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and have perused the record.
7. After being enlarged on bail by this Court on 19/4/2022 the applicant does appear to have appeared before the trial Court for a period of one and half years.
It is stated that due to non-information of the date of appearance by the counsel he could not appear on 23/11/2023 and on all subsequent dates.
The applicant has undertaken to cooperate in the trial and has categorically submitted that there shall not be even a single non- appearance on his part.
Thus in my opinion, the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.
8 . Accordingly the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond to the tune NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:32075 3 MCRC-48140-2024 o f Rs.50,000/ - with two solvent sureties of Rs.25,000/- each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his regular appearance before the trial Court on all the dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the said Court till completion of the trial.
9. This order shall be subject to the condition that the same shall stand recalled automatically even if there is a single non-condoned non-appearance on behalf of the applicant.
C.c. as per rules.

(PRANAY VERMA) JUDGE SS/-
